picks.title: When design becomes the organisation, and AI becomes the designer
picks.excerpt: Argues that as AI takes over the act of designing, the designer's real object of work shifts to the organisation itself — shaping the systems, taste, and guardrails that machines design within. A fresh Design-AX framing distinct from the terminal/orchestration/taste essays already published.
picks.rationale: Fresh Design-AX framing — the designer's object of work moves from screens to the org itself; distinct from prior terminal/orchestration essays.

picks.title: What 32 design leaders do when told to move faster
picks.excerpt: Design timelines are collapsing because AI turned weeks of research into days and afternoons of concepting into minutes — the piece surveys how 32 design leaders actually respond to the resulting speed pressure without wrecking craft.
picks.rationale: Actionable playbook from 32 leaders on absorbing AI speed pressure without wrecking craft — changes how design teams organize tomorrow.

picks.title: Agent's Design — design resources built for Cursor, Claude Code, Codex, v0, Bolt, Lovable
picks.excerpt: A packaged set of design resources aimed at stopping AI coding agents from shipping the same generic UI — feeding Cursor, Claude Code, Codex, v0, Bolt and Lovable with reusable design-system context so generated interfaces carry real taste.
picks.rationale: Concrete design-system resource that injects taste into AI coding agents (Cursor, Claude Code, v0, Bolt) — directly usable in a designer's toolchain.

picks.title: This new AI model thinks in images, not just words
picks.excerpt: After a decade of word-based LLMs, researchers are betting on models that reason directly in images rather than text — a shift toward visual-native AI that could reshape how designers and creatives collaborate with generative tools.
picks.rationale: Novel visual-native reasoning shift with credible Fast Company reporting — reframes how designers may collaborate with generative tools.

picks.title: New AI super-assistant sits on your desk and 'works unlimited hours', handling everything from email to coding
picks.excerpt: Autonomous' Intern 2 is a desktop AI agent with a voice and 'a mind' pitched at creatives — promising to take on the work of a small creative team across email, research and coding, testing how much of a studio's grunt work an always-on agent can absorb.
picks.rationale: A concrete always-on desktop agent pitched at creatives — tests how much studio grunt work an autonomous assistant can absorb.
